name: Exp_ColorXXDPO
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXXDPO custom indicator, which is a double-smoothed Detrended Price Oscillator. It opens buy positions when the DPO turns upward and sell positions when the DPO turns downward, with configurable buy/sell open and close logic switches.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXXDPO自定义指标进行交易，该指标是双重平滑的去趋势价格振荡器。当DPO向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并提供可配置的买卖开平仓逻辑开关。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于去趋势价格振荡器（DPO）的双重平滑版本，通过识别振荡器的转折点来捕捉价格动量的变化。入场条件：当DPO值从下降转为上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓，当DPO值从上升转为下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件：当DPO转折时平掉反向仓位，即DPO下转时平多仓，DPO上转时平空仓，同时也设置了固定的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持多种保证金模式包括固定手数、基于余额百分比等。资金管理使用了MarginMode枚举提供的多种模式，从自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金到固定手数，灵活度较高。策略在信号检测时使用了新K线判断机制，避免同一根K线内重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a double-smoothed Detrended Price Oscillator (DPO) that identifies momentum shifts by detecting turning points in the oscillator. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the DPO value turns upward (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and a sell position opens when the DPO value turns downward (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions: opposing positions are closed on DPO reversals—long positions close when DPO turns down, short positions close when DPO turns up, with additional fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, supporting multiple margin modes including fixed lot size, balance-based percentage, and free margin-based calculations. Money management leverages the MarginMode enum offering flexibility from free margin, balance, loss-adjusted margin, to fixed lot sizing. The strategy employs a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trading within the same bar and uses a SignalBar parameter to allow signal confirmation on a delayed bar.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 每笔交易的资金比例或手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/亏损后余额/固定手数）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号确认使用的K线索引

pros: 使用双重平滑DPO指标，能有效过滤市场噪音，减少虚假信号
提供买卖开平仓的独立开关，灵活性高，可以只开仓不平仓或只平仓不开仓
支持多种资金管理模式和多种平滑算法，适应不同交易风格
使用新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复开仓
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本的风险控制
pros_en: Double-smoothed DPO indicator effectively filters market noise and reduces false signals
Independent buy/sell open/close switches provide high flexibility for partial strategy execution
Multiple money management modes and smoothing algorithms accommodate various trading styles
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate entries within the same candle
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide basic risk control
cons: 没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能频繁触发虚假信号导致亏损
没有检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能导致同方向重复开仓
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，对大多数货币对不太实际
依赖于自定义指标ColorXXDPO，如果指标文件缺失则EA完全无法运行
缺少最大持仓数量和最大回撤限制等高级风控措施
cons_en: No spread filter, which may cause frequent false signal triggers and losses in high-spread environments
No check for existing same-direction positions, potentially leading to duplicate entries in the same direction
Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are excessively large for most currency pairs
Heavy dependency on the custom ColorXXDPO indicator—EA is completely non-functional if the indicator file is missing
Lacks advanced risk controls such as maximum position count and maximum drawdown limits
improvements: 增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，提高在高波动和高点差环境下的稳定性
增加对已有同方向持仓的检查，避免重复开仓，并添加最大回撤保护机制
improvements_en: Add a spread filter and maximum position count limit to improve stability in high-volatility and high-spread environments
Add checks for existing same-direction positions to prevent duplicate entries, and implement a maximum drawdown protection mechanism

risk_points: 没有点差过滤，在流动性差的市场中可能因滑点和点差造成意外亏损
未检查同方向已有持仓，可能在趋势行情中不断加仓导致过度敞口
默认止损止盈值过大，如未根据具体品种调整可能导致较大浮亏
risk_points_en: No spread filter may cause unexpected losses from slippage and wide spreads in illiquid markets
No same-direction position check may lead to excessive exposure by repeatedly adding positions during trends
Excessively large default SL/TP values may lead to significant floating losses if not adjusted per instrument
